summary: Tested the Ops-only 'Bulk Upload Images' feature end-to-end. Backend (8/8 pytest cases pass, forming a full regression for POST /api/ops/vendors/{vendor_id}/bulk-images): case-insensitive matching updates only image_url + updated_at (name/price/description untouched, no new items created), non-image files are skipped with 'Not an image file', unknown names skipped with 'No matching menu item', invalid ZIP returns 400 with 'not a valid ZIP archive' detail, unknown vendor returns 404, unauthenticated returns 401/403, operations role is 403 on an unassigned vendor and 200 once admin assigns the vendor (assignment reverted afterwards). Frontend Ops dashboard (1280x900, admin @ /ops/vendor/dv_namma): 'Upload Images' button renders in the Menu Items section header between 'Import Excel' and 'Add Item' (verified via x-coordinates 909 < 1042 < 1188). Clicking it opens the 'Bulk Upload Images' Sheet showing 'How to name your images' instructions plus 'Download menu item names' and 'Upload ZIP of Images' buttons. Download-names click succeeds without the 'no menu items' warning. Ops role vendor scoping already correct (Chaitanya sees 0 vendors via /api/ops/vendors since none are assigned).
critical_code_review_comments: Nit: /app/frontend/src/ops/BulkImages.tsx and /app/frontend/app/ops/vendor/[id].tsx use no testID on interactive elements (Upload Images button, Sheet buttons). Not blocking — text selectors work — but adding testIDs like `bulk-images-open`, `bulk-images-download-names`, `bulk-images-pick-zip` would make future E2E more robust.

Nit: /app/backend/server.py:1443 gates ops by `assigned_ops`, which matches the docs; however `_bulk_update_images` reads `zf.read(info)` fully into memory per image and then re-encodes to base64 — for very large ZIPs this could be memory-heavy. Not a bug, just a note; the per-image 5MB cap keeps it bounded.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test uploads used 1x1 transparent PNGs so image_url on 'Masala Dosa' and 'Filter Coffee' for vendor dv_namma has been overwritten with data:image/png;base64,... placeholders. RBAC test briefly assigned dv_namma to ops user Chaitanya and reverted assigned_ops back to '' (its prior value). No new users, vendors, or items were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu items for dv_namma at time of test: Masala Dosa, Idli Vada Combo, Filter Coffee, Ghee Pongal. Backend PUT /api/ops/vendors/{id} requires the FULL OpsVendorBody (name+email+…); when toggling assigned_ops in tests, GET the vendor first and echo back all required fields (see test_bulk_images.py::_put_assigned). Ops login button on /ops shows 'Log In' text twice (tab + submit) — click the last occurrence. Backend expected 400 detail wording is 'That file is not a valid ZIP archive.' (partial match 'not a valid ZIP' passes).
